title: Transition Pull-Up vs Layup Decision
description: A ball handler in transition reads whether the retreating defender has cut off the rim, choosing between a pull-up jumper and a drive to the basket.

content.objective: Choose between a pull-up jumper and a drive to the rim based on where the retreating defender sets up.
content.setup: A ball handler pushes the ball in transition against one retreating defender.
instructions: The ball handler attacks at full speed toward the basket.
If the defender retreats to protect the rim, the ball handler pulls up for a jumper before reaching them.
If the defender is late, the ball handler attacks all the way to the rim for a layup.
Reset with the defender varying how early or late they retreat.
coachingPoints: Make the read early, well before reaching the defender.
Stay balanced on the pull-up rather than rushing it off a full sprint.
Attack downhill with conviction once the layup is the right read.
commonMistakes: Pulling up even when the rim was actually open.
Forcing a layup into a set defender instead of taking the available jumper.
Jogging back instead of sprinting to get into position.
content.safety: Keep the drive at a controlled, game-realistic intensity.
